notes: WordPress + FacetWP listing (window.FWP_JSON, ajaxurl https://careers.airbnb.com/wp-json/facetwp/v1/refresh). The page POSTs a facetwp_refresh JSON body to https://careers.airbnb.com/positions/ with data.facets = {search_input: "<text>", departments: [slugs], where_you_work: [slugs], workplace_type: [slugs], jobs_sort: ""|"job_title"|"updated_at"} plus data.template="wp", data.extras.sort="default" and data.paged; response JSON carries settings.pager.total_rows and the filtered template HTML. Confirmed live: search_input "engineer" + departments ["engineering"] + where_you_work ["india"] + jobs_sort "updated_at" -> total_rows 2. Unfiltered total_rows 203, all 203 listed through the pager. Employee postings have no employment-type facet; the linked Magnit contractor community (separate flow) publishes contract roles, so no employment_type field is claimed here.
